statements.status_notes: httplib2 is reached through gsutil's HTTP transport for Google Cloud Storage backups, so the code is in the execute path. gsutil pins it exactly: gsutil 5.37 requires httplib2 0.20.4, and 5.37 is the newest gsutil release published, so no gsutil version allows the fixed httplib2 0.32.0. Resolves when gsutil relaxes its httplib2 pin.

httplib2 is reached through gsutil's HTTP transport for Google Cloud Storage backups, so the code is in the execute path. gsutil pins it exactly: gsutil 5.37 requires httplib2 0.20.4, and 5.37 is the newest gsutil release published, so no gsutil version allows the fixed httplib2 0.32.0. Resolves when gsutil relaxes its httplib2 pin.

httplib2 0.20.4 is gsutil's vendored HTTP client (platform/gsutil/third_party/httplib2). CVE-2026-59939 is a decompression resource-exhaustion (DoS) that requires an attacker-controlled, maliciously compressed HTTP response body. gsutil communicates only with Google Cloud Storage and Google API endpoints over authenticated TLS, so the response source is not adversary-controlled in the tool's intended use and the compression-bomb path cannot be triggered.
